+# Response caching
+
+All API responses except the probe endpoints (/health, /metrics)
+are served from the cache; the origin is only contacted to
+repopulate it on expiry.
+
+## Probe wiring
+
+/health and /metrics bypass the cache and always hit origin
+services, so probes reflect live state.
